card.name: Inside capitalized adverb stems
card.fires_on: The first part of an adverb written in ALL CAPS, just before an ending like -ALLY, -ABLY, -ELY or -FULLY. It appears in uppercase warning text on drug labels.

modes.label: Stem before -ALLY
modes.description: Capitalized stem such as POT-ENT or GENER that is completed by -ALLY.

card.writes: It pushes the model to finish the word with an adverb ending such as -ally, -ily, -ely or -ably.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of an all-caps adverb, when the word still needs its -ly ending.
